routeHint: Type the URL directly; the item is not in the default sidebar. t187c now has 348 active members carrying a profession_industry_id across 22 industries and interest custom field 452 populated, so both the industry list and the Interests panel render with real counts. KNOWN LIMIT: the Interests and Industries panels share one sticky left column (.column.is-one-quarter, max-height 100vh, overflow-y auto) and each table is styled height:calc(100vh - 300px), so together they always exceed the column by design and no viewport fits both whole. The Interests panel renders first, which is why an unscrolled shot ends at the Industries header. This spec scrolls the column to the industry rows, because the zero-count industry list was the defect being fixed; the alt text on professional-network.mdx was reworded to match what is in frame.
alt: Professional network page with the interests and industry lists in the left column, each row showing its member count, next to a grid of member cards with name and profession headline

routeHint: Settings -> Modules -> Professions. Requires ADMIN_TENANT. preper has isActive, hasIndustry, hasJob and hasExpertise all true so every switch shows on.

routeHint: Settings -> Modules -> Professions -> Profession Industries in the left menu. The menu entry only appears when Enable Industry Tracking is on. Scroll so both a Custom and a Global row are visible if the tenant has custom industries.
alt: Industries admin table with Industry Name, type tagged Custom or Global, an enabled checkbox per row, and bulk buttons for enabling or disabling all custom and all default industries
